title: Flowers on the Trail

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: Isn't it beautiful out here in spring? The deer have new fawns, and the first flowers are opening.

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: I've brought some little plants to make a border along the trail. Can you carry on my pattern?

steps.speaker: miriam
steps.prompt: Carry on the pattern of flowers. What comes next?

older.prompt: Carry on the pattern: yellow, blue, red, blue. What comes next?

feedback.all_good: A whole border of spring flowers along the trail!

outro.speaker: miriam
outro.text: Whoever walks this way will smile when they see these. A little gift for strangers!

journal_line: I planted a border of spring flowers along the wilderness trail with Miss Miriam.
